title: Co-Scientist and aging: metabolism and the integrated stress response
summary: Calico Life Sciences used Co-Scientist to formulate the hypothesis that metabolism regulates the cellular integrated stress response, refined experiments with the tool, and reports new findings. The post gives no numerical data, and the results have not yet been published or peer reviewed.
organization: Google DeepMind and Calico Life Sciences

evidence.tested: Calico reports that experiments were run with the Co-Scientist hypothesis and produced new findings; the post does not describe the experiments, assays or results.
evidence.unknown: Not reported (the results are not yet published; the team plans to publish them).
evidence.ai_role: Co-Scientist generated the hypothesis that metabolism regulates the integrated stress response, and was used to refine experimental design.
